common.readOnly: Read-only: editing from the dashboard is turned off (DASHBOARD_EDIT_ENABLED is not true).
common.confirmOnce: This confirmation works once and expires in 5 minutes.
common.name: Name
common.fillsForm: (fills in the form; you add a reason there)

profile.title: Bot profile
profile.help: How the bot looks on Discord, everywhere. Discord limits how often the name and images can change; its answer is shown here when it refuses.
profile.upload: Or upload (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 8 MB)
profile.usernameLimit: Discord allows only a few username changes per hour.

servers.title: Servers
servers.noServers: The bot is in no server.
servers.summary: Every server the bot is in: {servers}, {members} members in total, {week} joined in the last 7 days.
servers.summaryShort: Every server the bot is in ({total}).

server.inviteHelp: You own this server or have Administrator there. The invite works once and expires after 1 hour.
server.blacklisted: Blacklisted: the bot ignores this server
server.cannotBlacklist: The main and the support server cannot be blacklisted.

missing.one: The bot is missing {count} permission it asks for when added; those features fail here.
missing.other: The bot is missing {count} permissions it asks for when added; those features fail here.

server.allPermissions: The bot has every permission it asks for when added.
server.rolesAbove: These roles are at or above the bot's highest role{top}, so the bot cannot give or remove them. Move the bot's role above them in Server Settings → Roles.
server.noRoleAbove: No known role the bot manages (Muted, warning or Banned role) is above its highest role ({top}).
server.cacheNote: Member counts come from the bot's member cache, which is not complete for this server.
server.leaveHelp: The bot leaves this server. Only someone with Manage Server there can add it back.
server.cannotLeave: The main and the support server cannot be left from here.
server.leaveEffect: The bot leaves the server now. Its settings and records stay in the database.

users.title: Users
users.help: Look up one Discord user by ID: account, shared servers, blacklist and the main server's moderation record. Read-only.
users.openMemberNote: (Members area; actions there need Administrator in the main server)
users.blacklistUnknown: The blacklist could not be read (database). Reload to try again.
users.sharedNote: The main and the support server are asked directly. Every other server is checked only in the bot's member cache, which is often incomplete, so the user may be in a server not listed here.
users.downloadNote: for a data request (Privacy Policy). Logged in Owner activity.

blacklist.title: Blacklist
blacklist.help: Blacklisted users get “You can't use this bot.” for every command, button and form. A blacklisted server is ignored: the bot does not answer its commands. Bot owners can never be blacklisted.

home.title: Owner overview
home.help: The bot across every server. Only bot owners (OWNER_IDS) see this area.
home.maintenanceOn: Maintenance mode is on: only bot owners can run commands.
home.serversSub: {members} members in total · {week} new this week

activity.title: Owner activity
activity.help: Everything done in the Owner area: profile changes, invites, leaving servers, blacklist, maintenance, announcements and command re-registration. Not shown in the server's audit log.
activity.loadError: The activity could not be loaded (database). Reload the page to try again.

health.title: Health
health.logsHelp: Since the last restart, newest first ({counts}). Kept in memory only; tokens, passwords and long keys are masked. The full lines are in the host's logs.
health.noLogs: No warnings or errors since the last restart.
health.blacklistNotLoaded: Not loaded: nobody is blocked until the database answers (retrying)
health.maintenanceOnText: On: only bot owners can run commands.

commands.title: Command sync
commands.help: The bot's global slash commands and context menus (every server) compared with the bot's list. /database (owner-tools server only) is not shown or changed here.
commands.inSync: In sync: Discord has exactly the commands the bot registers.
commands.missingNote: In the bot's list but not registered: members cannot use them.
commands.extra: On Discord but not in the bot's list
commands.extraNote: Left over from an older version or another registration; using them fails.
commands.noComparison: No comparison: one side could not be read (see above).
commands.retiredNote: (RETIRE_ADMIN_COMMANDS is on: everyone-commands and the owner kit only)
commands.reregisterHelp: Sends the bot's list to Discord again, with the same code the bot runs at startup (RETIRE_ADMIN_COMMANDS applied the same way). It replaces the whole global list. A changed global list can take up to an hour to show in every Discord client. You confirm on the next page.
commands.confirmEffect: The global command list is replaced by the bot's list in one request, exactly as at startup. Every server sees the change, which can take up to an hour.

announce.title: Announce
announce.help: One plain-text message to every server's log channel (alerts or mod log in the main server, else the logging channel). Mentions never ping. You confirm on the next page.
announce.noTarget: No server has a log channel the bot can post in.
announce.whereHelp: Leave a server on Default to use its log channel. Pick another channel to post there instead, this time only.

premium.title: Premium keys
premium.help: Create keys for Normal, Pro or Max. Anyone who logs in on the website (My record → Subscription) can redeem a key once; it adds the plan and time to their account. Same plan: the time is added to the end date. Test mode only: no payments are connected.
premium.checkoutOff: Redeeming and the checkout are off: set `PREMIUM_TEST_CHECKOUT=true` (and `MEMBER_PORTAL_ENABLED=true`) to turn them on. Keys created now still work once it is on.
premium.newKeysNote: {plan}, {days} days each. They also stay in the list below.
premium.giveHelp: Straight to an account, no key needed. Same rules as a key: same plan adds time, a higher plan converts the remaining time, a lower one is refused. The member gets a DM and the supporter role.
premium.rolesHelp: One role per plan in the main server. An active plan gives its role and removes the other two; when the plan ends the role is removed. Checked every 5 minutes, on rejoin and right after every change. Roles the bot cannot hand out are marked.
premium.keysError: The keys could not be loaded (database). Reload the page to try again.
premium.cancelConfirm: Cancel {code}? It can no longer be redeemed.
premium.subscriptionsError: The subscriptions could not be loaded (database).
premium.ordersError: The orders could not be loaded (database).

erase.title: Erase a case
erase.help: For a privacy request (right to erasure). Enter the case code; the next page shows the case and what will happen before anything changes.
erase.note: The values in the dashboard audit log for this case are replaced too (who and when stay). Messages the bot already posted (mod log, DMs) are not changed; delete those in Discord if needed.
erase.storedValue: {notes} note(s), {evidence} evidence item(s), {edits} edit(s), {appeals} appeal(s) / report(s)
erase.effectAnonymise: This is a warn that still counts on the warn ladder, so the case stays as a counted row: its reason, name, tags, notes, edit history and appeal texts are replaced with “[removed on request]”, its evidence is deleted. The ladder does not change.
erase.effectDelete: The case is deleted with its notes, evidence, edit history and appeals. The warn ladder does not change.
